title: Human Resource Intern - Capability Development Partner

titleByLocale.en: Human Resource Intern - Capability Development Partner

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• Are you ready to dive into an immersive learning experience where you don't just observe, but actively contribute and implement vital Organization Enablement initiatives? Join us in shaping the future of our organizations together! Key Responsibilities
• Embark on a journey to understand and contribute to transformative Organization Enablement initiatives, focusing on areas such as:
• Capability Framework: Bring your passion to enhance the efficiency of our Capability Framework, supporting our organization's future workforce needs and driving efficiencies.
• Learning and Development: Dive into the essence of our RSS Academy, supporting its mission to empower our workforce through continuous learning and development opportunities.
• Employee Engagement and Change Communications: Creatively designing, crafting communications and presentations supporting our initiatives
• Collaborate and Innovate: Bring your tech-savvy or creative mindset to co-create innovative solutions with diverse teams for the key initiatives you spearhead. It will be an added advantage if you know tools like g-suite & other automation tools
• Additional Support : Be prepared to lend a hand in various other support activities and initiatives as needed to keep the momentum going. We're Seeking Someone Who:
• Embodies Curiosity: Whether you're an undergraduate or a recent graduate from a renowned university, we're looking for individuals with insatiable curiosity and a knack for reimagining the status quo.
• Thrives in Creativity: Are you a wordsmith? Social media enthusiast? Digital marketing whiz? Do you excel in creating engaging slideshow presentations? Can you develop captivating videos? These skills are considered a significant advantage in our dynamic environment.
• Values Collaboration: Join a team that values collaboration above all else. We're seeking individuals who thrive in diverse environments and carry a strong sense of ownership for their contributions.
• Communicates with Impact: From verbal discussions to written reports, your English communication skills should be top-notch.
• Driven Individuals: We seek candidates who are self-motivated, willing to take initiative, and possess a solution-oriented mindset.
• PR and Event Management Savvy: Strong skills in public relations and event management are highly valued in this role.
• Commits to Growth: Ready to embark on a journey? We're seeking interns who can commit to a minimum of 6 months, preferably a year, to truly immerse themselves in this transformative experience. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a he
